subject: world_language
concept: Answering spontaneous follow-up questions about a presentation or piece of writing in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B2 'handle spontaneous questions' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student practices responding to unscripted follow-up questions from the persona about their own presentation
exercise.abstract: Student answers a spontaneous follow-up question about their work clearly and relevantly in the target language

misconception_flags: responds to a follow-up question with a memorized script unrelated to what was actually asked

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
